name: Tomb of Askia
description: Rising about 17 metres above the city of Gao in Mali, this stepped mud-brick pyramid bbristles with wooden stakes and marks the burial place of Askia Mohamed, emperor of Songhai. He built it in 1495, after returning from Mecca, with two mud mosques and a cemetery beside it. It is Gao's largest pre-colonial monument, and it is still used for worship.
